checks.rule: Progressive steering is copied, frozen, validated and included in physics identity
checks.input: Construct with mutable nested settings; change caller data; compare reversed property order and reject malformed values.
checks.expected: No caller alias; canonical identity; invalid settings rejected; prior Fast and F1 identities stay exact when shaping is absent.

checks.rule: Low-speed response blends continuously into the unchanged high-speed response
checks.input: Sweep0–140m/s in.001m/s steps, probe negative speeds and the exact12/45m/s transition endpoints.
checks.expected: Rise stays .18–.5s and exponent1–1.35; monotonic smooth blend; high-speed endpoints exactly .18s/1.

checks.rule: Brief low-speed steering presses make gentler real trajectory corrections

input.script: Start3/8/13m/s; Gas+Right for50/100/200ms; release steering and keep Gas for.5s. Compare the exact previous Fast setup.

checks.expected: Every correction remains positive and below35% of the previous yaw change; no stationary rotation or direction reversal; exact states at all rates.

checks.rule: Longer holds progressively reach the full existing wheel angle

input.script: At rest hold Right .1/.25/.4/.6s; measure actual wheel angle; separately observe first full angle and release.

checks.expected: Angles strictly increase with hold duration, reach30degrees within.5s+one tick and center within.14s+one tick; yaw remains0; milestones must be observed.

checks.rule: High-speed driving traces retain the approved response and cornering capacity exactly

input.script: Start60/80.4672/98.3488m/s; Gas plus alternating analog steering for3s; compare prior Fast on every tick. Grant boost initially at220mph.

checks.expected: Above45m/s all physical state, inputs, angles, momentum and grip telemetry match bit for bit; only profile identity differs.

checks.rule: Gentle input remains analog, mirrored and independent of world orientation

input.script: At8m/s apply signed .2/.5/1 steering with .4 throttle for1s; mirror each run.

checks.expected: Stronger input gives stronger turning; left/right paths mirror; all rates agree and release returns to center.

checks.rule: A genuinely hard held turn can still slide and spin, then recover after release

input.script: Start13m/s; Gas+full Right3s, then release Right and keep Gas2.5s; mirror the full input.

checks.expected: Peak sideways speed>5m/s and slip>0.5rad; body turns>PI; no yaw snap>.06rad/tick; after release sideways speed<.01m/s and yaw rate<.001rad/s.

checks.rule: The broad hard-turn release matrix does not leave neutral steering stuck

input.script: For every speed/hold, Gas+Right then release steering4s with Gas held or released. Observe all ticks after2s.

checks.expected: 432 scenarios: wheel input centers; sideways speed<.01m/s and yaw rate<.001rad/s after2s; finite state and exact terminal states across FPS.

checks.rule: Large initial sideways slip settles without steering in either direction

input.script: Initial30m/s world velocity at each signed angle from the body; Gas with neutral steering5s.

checks.expected: No spontaneous yaw; finite state; final sideways speed<.01m/s; left/right mirror and exact FPS states.
